lanes.summary: A purchase ends with "You're all set" and drops the user on Home. Declining the offer brings a spin-the-wheel discount and an "80% OFF FOREVER" one-time offer, and Apple briefly pulled the app in April 2026 for this and for misleading pricing. Pending and failed purchases were not observed.

lanes.summary: A doubtful scan can be fixed in place: "Fix Issue", a "Report Food" box, and a candid "Ingredients hidden" note when the AI isn't confident. For the hard error "Food items were not processed" the FAQ's only advice is to reinstall. No retry, timeout or rate-limit screen was observed, and the scan limit only appears as a paywall on +.

lanes.summary: No AI-specific consent was found. Food photos go to the server for analysis, and the May 2026 privacy notice names no AI vendor and shows no in-app step for granting or withdrawing AI sharing. The closest consent traced is ads: the notice says you opt in or out under profile settings, per device.
sources: https://www.calai.app/privacy (Effective May 21, 2026: no AI vendor named; 'opt in, or opt out of such advertising through our app… visiting your profile settings'; 'reflected at a browser or device level'; withdrawal of consent right)
